rows.title: Vitamin D3 4000 IU with breakfast
rows.why: Vitamin D 32.68 is below 40; take it with the day's first fat.

rows.title: Psyllium husk 10 g daily
rows.why: LDL 131 is above the 70–100 goal; soluble fibre binds bile acids.

rows.title: Walk 10 minutes after the largest meal
rows.why: Lowers the glucose peak after eating and moves LDL a little.

rows.title: Resistance training 30 minutes
rows.why: Muscle is where glucose goes; the cheapest lever for early insulin resistance.

rows.title: Protein and fibre at the start of every meal
rows.why: Eating them first flattens the glucose curve of the rest of the plate.

rows.title: Magnesium glycinate 200 mg at bedtime
rows.why: Magnesium sits low in its band and edge magnesium->sleep_quality exists; cheap to try before judging sleep.
